create_HabitatLogger_with_file_output: create a HabitatLogger instance that writes log messages to a specified file with a custom format string
create_HabitatLogger_with_stream_output: create a HabitatLogger instance that writes log messages to stdout using a StreamHandler
add_filehandler_to_logger: add an additional FileHandler to an existing HabitatLogger instance to log to a new file
use_module_logger_instance: use the pre-configured habitat module-level logger instance to log INFO level messages with timestamps
configure_HabitatLogger_format_and_style: configure a HabitatLogger with a custom format string, date format, and percent-style formatting
